obligations.source_text: Create a photorealistic vertical 4:5 environmental portrait inside a disused circular coastal-lighthouse lens-servicing gallery just after a rain squall. Show exactly one clearly adult person; treat the person as an original fictional adult and use the supplied reference only for visible appearance: long dark softly wavy hair with a near-center part and a few fine loose strands, dark eyes, a calm closed-mouth expression and steady direct gaze, a matte black lightweight V-neck blouse, and a fine short gold-tone necklace with a tiny central detail. Add charcoal high-waisted trousers and weathered dark ankle boots. The adult stands naturally beside a waist-high brass carriage holding a large segmented Fresnel lens, one hand firmly turning its handwheel and the other lightly bracing the circular frame, with both hands anatomically clear. A hard low sunrise beam enters through a narrow high east-facing window at upper left, passes through the visibly illuminated Fresnel lens, then through a clearly visible perforated brass safety screen. It creates one broad diagonal rainbow-tinted oval lattice as the unmistakable first-read event. Show that same projection beginning on the curved aged off-white glazed-tile wall, bending and compressing with the wall, then crossing the adult through aligned colored openings and dark oval interruptions over hair, one cheek, collarbone, blouse, forearm, and wheel hand. Continue it over the near edge of the brass carriage and stretch it in perspective across a shallow rainwater film on the gray stone floor toward lower right. Maintain one projection direction, repeating oval rhythm, and consistent spectral order while its geometry conforms to wall, face, fabric, metal, and wet floor; opaque occlusions interrupt it naturally. Keep the illuminated window, lens segments, screen, wall segment, adult, handwheel, and floor continuation visible together. Frame from waist height with a full-frame 35 mm viewpoint about 2.8 meters away, slightly right of the optical axis with a gentle downward tilt, a three-quarter-length adult slightly right of center, the apparatus in the upper-left third, and broad wet floor in the lower-right foreground. Use moderate depth of field around f/5.6. Balance hard warm refracted sunrise against cool blue-gray room ambience about two stops darker. Preserve realistic skin, matte fabric, curved tile, tarnished brass, salt residue, damp footprints, coherent shadow direction, gentle highlight rolloff, restrained spectral color, and fine 35 mm color-negative grain. The photograph has quiet cinematic documentary realism with restrained fashion-editorial precision.
